description: Scores all five AFT events (deadlift, hand-release push-ups, sprint-drag-carry, plank, 2-mile run) from 0 to 100 each using the 17-21 anchor tables, for a 500-point total. Combat MOS scoring is sex-neutral and requires 350 total with every event at 60 or above; the general standard requires every event at 60 or above. Use when a soldier provides Army Fitness Test event results and wants the scores and pass or fail. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive AFT calculator.

plank_time.description: Plank hold time as m:ss (or total seconds).

run_time.description: 2-mile run time as m:ss (or total seconds).

sex.description: Sex for the scoring tables (ignored for combat, which is sex-neutral).

sprint_drag_carry_time.description: Sprint-drag-carry time as m:ss (or total seconds).

standard.description: Scoring standard: general or combat MOS.

name: calculate_aft

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.
